q.g: In this quest you have to mark 3 yellow minibuses with MS2000 Markers on Interchange. The first one is located southwest of the mall at the container lot. The other two are in the western parking garage. One of them can be found at the transition from section B to section C, close to the blocked-off down-ramp. The second one is located in section C, right next to the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction and the hole in the wall that connects the western with the eastern parking garage.

sh.c: Minibus 2 close to the blocked-off down-ramp
